section: India-Russia, India-EU, India-Japan, India-Israel, India-Gulf and India-Africa relations

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II with reference to India's economic agreements:

List-I (Agreement type)
a. CEPA with South Korea
b. CEPA with Japan
c. CECA with Singapore
d. CECA with Malaysia

List-II (Year)
i. 2005
ii. 2010
iii. 2011
iv. 2011

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: India signed the CEPA with South Korea in 2010 and with Japan in 2011. The CECAs with Singapore and Malaysia were signed in 2005 and 2011, respectively.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive year-partner pairs and then eliminate codes that reverse the two 2011 agreements.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II with reference to India's economic agreements:

List-I (Agreement type)
a. CECPA with Mauritius
b. CEPA with the UAE
c. ECTA with Australia
d. TEPA with EFTA

List-II (Partner and year)
i. Australia — 2022
ii. EFTA — 2024
iii. Mauritius — 2021
iv. UAE — 2022

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: The CECPA with Mauritius was concluded in 2021, the CEPA with the UAE and ECTA with Australia in 2022, and the TEPA with EFTA in 2024.
accepted.tq: Use the agreement acronyms as anchors and verify the partner-year pair before selecting the code.

accepted.s:
Consider the following agreements:
1. CETA with the United Kingdom
2. CEPA with Oman
3. TEPA with EFTA

Which one of the agreements given above was concluded in 2025?
accepted.x: The CETA with the United Kingdom was concluded in 2025, and the CEPA with Oman was signed in 2025. The TEPA with EFTA belongs to 2024.
accepted.tq: Separate agreements by year and identify the two entries sharing 2025 rather than relying on the acronym alone.

accepted.s: With reference to the India-Oman economic partnership, which one of the following is correct?
o: The CEPA was signed in 2024 and entered into force in 2025.
The CEPA was signed in 2026 and entered into force on 1 June 2026.
The CEPA was signed in 2025 but has not entered into force.
The CEPA was signed in 2025 and entered into force on 1 June 2026.
accepted.x: India and Oman signed the CEPA in 2025, and it entered into force on 1 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Track both the signing year and the precise date of entry into force to avoid confusing agreement status with conclusion.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly reflects a current development in India-European Union relations?
o: The India-EU FTA was concluded in 2025 and entered into force in 2026.
The India-EU FTA was concluded in 2026.
The India-EU FTA was signed in 2024 but is yet to be concluded.
India and the European Union have not initiated negotiations for an FTA.
accepted.x: The India-EU FTA was reported as concluded in 2026. No entry-into-force date is specified here.
accepted.tq: Distinguish conclusion of an agreement from its signing or entry into force.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Gulf region's importance to India:
1. The Gulf is India's largest socio-economic partner.
2. India-Gulf trade is valued at approximately 160 billion dollars.
3. Around 10 million members of the Indian diaspora live in the Gulf region.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the Gulf is India's largest socio-economic partner, bilateral trade is about 160 billion dollars, and the Indian diaspora there numbers approximately 10 million.
accepted.tq: Treat the status, trade figure and diaspora size as separate statements and check each quantitative detail.
